description: Attach an anonymously deployed drop to the authenticated account using its one-time claim token (spc_..., returned once by deploy_html/deploy_files). Claiming a live drop extends it to the free-account lifetime (30 days). A drop that already expired can still be claimed, but it stays expired until it's restored on Pro. Claimed drops become listable, deletable, and — on paid plans — redeployable via named drops. Requires an sp_ API key.

claim_token.description: The one-time spc_... token returned at deploy time.

slug.description: The drop slug (the subdomain part of its ${domain} URL).

name: claim_drop

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp after the claim's lifetime extension, or null

paused.description: True when the drop had already expired and joined the account offline; restoring it needs Pro

restored.description: True when the drop had already expired and was revived by the claim

title: Claim an anonymous drop
